title: 第830章 核弹轰蚊子极致原始道兵万世杀劫之威第829章 他没有心他是邪魔刽子手
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
这一拳跟之前那两拳截然不同。
拳锋上没有鎏金色的光柱，没有咆哮的金龙虚影，只有一轮金色的太阳。
那太阳从他拳头上冉冉升起，初时只有拳头大小，转瞬间便膨胀到了数十丈，再一眨眼已经照亮了半边天穹！
金色的光芒所到之处，灰雾蒸发，人脸消散，冤魂的尖叫声戛然而止。
那光芒中蕴含着一股煌煌天威，至阳至刚，专克一切邪祟污秽。
一如九天之上有一尊古老的神灵垂眸，降下了洗涤人间的净世之光。
“天帝拳！”
金光如海，席卷长空。
难以言喻的浩荡拳威充斥了眼球中的一切！
数十万道冤魂碎片在金光的冲刷下如同冰雪遇到了烈阳，连一息都没能撑过去就化为了漫天青烟。
那些扭曲的人脸在金光的照耀下终于褪去了痛苦和狰狞，浮现出最后一丝安详，然后缓缓消散在夜空中。
邪影发出一声凄厉到极致的惨叫。
它释放出那些神魂碎片本就已经伤及本源，此刻又被天帝拳正面轰中，周身的灰雾直接被蒸发掉了将近一半。
暗红色的长袍在金光中寸寸碎裂，露出下面那团不断翻涌的灰黑色核心。
它的气息在这一拳之后萎靡到了极点，连维持形体都变得勉强起来。
但它到底是活了不知道多少年的老怪物。
趁着天帝拳的余威还在空中扩散，它猛地咬碎了藏在核心深处的一枚灰黑色晶核。
随后毫不犹豫地施展了最后的保命秘法，体内剩余的所有力量连同那枚本源核心一起引爆，化为一道血色的献祭之光将它整个躯体包裹住。
虚空开始扭曲，黑色的缝隙异常狰狞！
这是血祭秘法强行撕裂空间壁垒，能将它的核心意识在瞬息之间传送到百万里之外。

代价是它九成九的力量都将永远留在这片天地间，但只要能活着逃出去。
不过重新吞噬几个小世界就能恢复过来，这些代价对于他来说简直不值一提！
与之相反的则是被彻底湮灭掉这具好不容易凝聚出来的躯壳。
“想跑？”
叶天澜的声音从它身后传来。
那声音不大，却带着一股不容置疑的霸道。
“已经晚了。”
他右手虚空一握。
轰然之间，无法言语的惊人杀机充斥了此方天地！
当此物出现的刹那，就连天地也为之黯然失色！
整个世界仿佛只剩下了黑白之色，所有的一切存在都已经消失了。
就见在他掌心之中，一节古朴的石质台阶悄然浮现而出。
那台阶不大，只有尺许来长，通体灰白，表面布满了密密麻麻的裂痕和磨损的痕迹，看上去就像是从哪座荒废了万年的古庙里随手捡来的残砖。
然而就在它出现的瞬间。
天地万物都安静了下来。
风停，云止。
连夜空中流淌了亿万年的星河都仿佛凝固在了苍穹之上。
“咚……”
“咚——”
“咚！”

一股难以用言语形容的杀伐之气从那节残破的石阶上弥漫开来。
那气息之古老、浩瀚、凌厉，让天地万物同时感到自己的心脏漏跳了一拍。
此物赫然竟是——
极致原始道兵！
万世杀劫路！！
content_en:
This punch was completely different from the previous two punches.
There is no golden beam of light on the fist, no shadow of the roaring golden dragon, only a golden sun.
The sun slowly rose from his fist. At first it was only the size of a fist, but in an instant it expanded to dozens of feet, and in the blink of an eye it illuminated half of the sky!
Wherever the golden light went, the gray mist evaporated, the faces disappeared, and the screams of the innocent souls stopped abruptly.
That light contains a brilliant divine power, which is extremely strong and can conquer all evil spirits and filth.
Just like there is an ancient god above the nine heavens lowering his eyes and sending down the light of purification that washes the world.
"Heavenly Emperor Fist!"
The golden light is like a sea, sweeping across the sky.
The indescribable mighty fist power filled everything in the eye!
Hundreds of thousands of broken soul fragments were washed away by the golden light like ice and snow meeting the blazing sun, and they turned into blue smoke all over the sky without even being able to hold on for a breath.
Under the golden light, those twisted human faces finally lost their pain and ferocity, revealing the last trace of peace, and then slowly dissipated into the night sky.
The evil shadow let out an extremely shrill scream.
The soul fragments it released had already damaged its origin, but at this moment, it was hit from the front by the Heavenly Emperor's Fist, and nearly half of the gray mist around it was evaporated.
The dark red robe was shattered inch by inch in the golden light, revealing the surging gray-black core underneath.
Its aura shrank to the extreme after this punch, and it was barely able to maintain its shape.
But it is an old monster that has lived for who knows how many years.
While the remaining power of the Heavenly Emperor's Fist was still spreading in the air, it suddenly bit into pieces a gray-black crystal core hidden deep in its core.
Then without hesitation, he used the last secret technique to save his life, and all the remaining power in his body detonated together with the original core, turning into a bloody sacrificial light that enveloped his entire body.
The void began to twist, and the black gaps were extremely ferocious!
This is the secret method of blood sacrifice that forcibly tears apart the space barrier, and can transport its core consciousness millions of miles away in an instant.
The price is that 99% of its power will remain in this world forever, but as long as it can escape alive.
However, he can recover by swallowing a few small worlds again, and these costs are simply not worth mentioning to him!
On the contrary, the body that was finally condensed was completely annihilated.
"Want to run?"
Ye Tianlan's voice came from behind it.
The voice was not loud, but it carried an unquestionable domineering tone.
"It's too late."
He held his right hand empty.
Suddenly, unspeakable and shocking murderous intent filled the world!
The moment this thing appeared, even the heaven and earth were eclipsed by it!
The whole world seemed to be only black and white, and all existence had disappeared.
In his palm, a simple stone step quietly emerged.
The steps were not big, only about a foot long. They were all gray and white, and the surface was covered with dense cracks and traces of wear. They looked like random bricks picked up from an ancient temple that had been abandoned for thousands of years.
But the moment it appeared.
Everything in heaven and earth became quiet.
The wind stops and the clouds stop.
Even the stars that have been flowing in the night sky for hundreds of millions of years seem to be frozen in the sky.
"Boom..."
"Dong——"
"Boom!"
An indescribable murderous aura spread from the broken stone steps.
The aura was so ancient, vast, and fierce that all creatures in the world felt their hearts skip a beat at the same time.
This thing is surprisingly——
The ultimate primitive Taoist soldier!
The path of eternal destruction and calamity! !
